    StorState) (Hlt : ls.lent = true) (Hr : σr.prev = σr.ss ∧ σr.ents = ls.stored ∧ σr.pend = [] ∧
    σr.fl = ls.fl) (Hk : σr.ss.index' ≠ W64 0 → { sid := σr.ss, cl := σr.scs, al := σr.sal, dat :=
    σr.sdat } ∈ ls.ksn) (Happ : uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z σr.prev.index') (Hhd : uint.Z σr.fl ≤
    uint.Z σr.hd ∧ uint.Z σr.hd ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index') : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls -∗ ownStorage
    ls.storage σr -∗ ownRaftLog l (logAbsorbSnap ls σr.ss)

theorem ownRaftLog_snap_next [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l
    ls -∗ ⌜∀ (sid : entryID), ls.snap = some sid → ls.sip = false → ls.prev = sid ∧ ls.sents = [] ∧
    nextUnstable ls = ls.sents ++ ls.uents ∧ 0 < uint.Z sid.index' ∧ uint.Z sid.index' < 2 ^ 61 ∧
    uint.Z ls.applying < uint.Z sid.index'⌝ ∗ ownRaftLog l ls

theorem persist_stable (σ : StorState) (sents uents stored : List EntryM) (ipo k : Int) (Hk : 0 ≤ k
    ∧ k ≤ ↑uents.length ∧ 0 ≤ ipo ∧ ipo ≤ ↑uents.length) (H : LogPersistOk σ sents uents ipo []
    stored) (Hst : ipo < k → stored = sents ++ List.take k.toNat uents) : LogPersistOk σ (sents ++
    List.take k.toNat uents) (List.drop k.toNat uents) (max ipo k - k) [] stored ∧ (List.drop
    k.toNat uents = [] → sents ++ List.take k.toNat uents = σ.ents)

theorem SnpOk.stableSnap {g : NGhost} {ls : LogState} (i : w64) (H : SnpOk g ls) : SnpOk g
    (logStableSnap ls i)

theorem ownRaftLog_snap_facts [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l
    ls -∗ ⌜(ls.lent = true → ls.snap ≠ none) ∧ (ls.sat = true → ls.snap = some ls.prev ∧ ls.sip =
    true ∧ ls.lent = false ∧ ls.unpersisted = []) ∧ (ls.snap = none → ls.sip = false) ∧ ∀ (sid :
    entryID), ls.snap = some sid → ls.prev = sid ∧ ls.sents = [] ∧ 0 < uint.Z sid.index'⌝ ∗
    ownRaftLog l ls

theorem logStableSnap_fields (ls : LogState) (i : w64) : (logStableSnap ls i).prev = ls.prev ∧
    (logStableSnap ls i).sents = ls.sents ∧ (logStableSnap ls i).uents = ls.uents ∧ (logStableSnap
    ls i).committed = ls.committed ∧ (logStableSnap ls i).applied = ls.applied ∧ (logStableSnap ls
    i).applying = ls.applying ∧ (logStableSnap ls i).inprogress = ls.inprogress ∧ (logStableSnap ls
    i).unpersisted = ls.unpersisted ∧ (logStableSnap ls i).stored = ls.stored ∧ (logStableSnap ls
    i).storage = ls.storage ∧ (logStableSnap ls i).ksn = ls.ksn ∧ (logStableSnap ls i).fl = ls.fl ∧
    (logStableSnap ls i).lent = ls.lent ∧ (logStableSnap ls i).apsize = ls.apsize ∧ (logStableSnap
    ls i).apmax = ls.apmax

theorem logAppliedTo.proj_prev (ls : LogState) (index size : w64) : (logAppliedTo ls index
    size).prev = ls.prev

def logStableSnap (ls : LogState) (i : w64) : LogState :=
  if snapHit ls.snap i = true then
    { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents, uents := ls.uents, committed := ls.committed, applied := ls.applied,
      snap := none, inprogress := ls.inprogress, applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted,
      stored := ls.stored, apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl,
      lent := ls.lent, aps := true, sxt := ls.sxt, stb := ls.stb, sdt := ls.sdt }
  else ls

    false

theorem logAcceptUnstable.proj_stored (ls : LogState) : (logAcceptUnstable ls).stored = ls.sents ++
    ls.uents

theorem logAbsorbSnap.proj_unpersisted (ls : LogState) (sid : entryID) : (logAbsorbSnap ls
    sid).unpersisted = []

theorem logAppliedTo.proj_applying (ls : LogState) (index size : w64) : (logAppliedTo ls index
    size).applying = w64Max ls.applying (w64Max index ls.applied)

theorem logLast_acceptUnstable (ls : LogState) : logLast (logAcceptUnstable ls) = logLast ls

def logEnd (ls : LogState) : w64 :=
  logLast ls + W64 1

theorem logAppliedTo.proj_sip (ls : LogState) (index size : w64) : (logAppliedTo ls index size).sip
    = ls.sip

def logStableTo (ls : LogState) (id : entryID) : LogState :=
  if StableHit ls id then
    have k := (uint.Z id.index' + 1 - logOffset ls).toNat;
    { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents ++ List.take k ls.uents, uents := List.drop k ls.uents,
      committed := ls.committed, applied := ls.applied, snap := ls.snap,
      inprogress := w64Max ls.inprogress (id.index' + W64 1), applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted,
      stored := ls.stored, apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl,
      sip := ls.sip, lent := ls.lent, sapp := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps, sat := ls.sat, sxt := ls.sxt, stb := ls.stb,
      sdt := ls.sdt }
  else ls

def logAcceptUnstable (ls : LogState) : LogState :=
  { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents, uents := ls.uents, committed := ls.committed, applied := ls.applied,
    snap := ls.snap, inprogress := logEnd ls, applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := nextUnstable ls,
    stored := ls.sents ++ ls.uents, apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn,
    fl := ls.fl, sip := ls.sip || ls.snap.isSome, lent := ls.lent, sapp := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps, sxt := ls.sxt,
    stb := ls.stb, sdt := ls.sdt }

theorem logAcceptUnstable.proj_prev (ls : LogState) : (logAcceptUnstable ls).prev = ls.prev

    (hsn : ls'.snap = ls.snap) (hsx : ls'.sxt = ls.sxt) (hap : uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z
    ls'.applying) (haps : ls.aps = true → ∀ (k : SnapTrip), g.snp = some k → uint.Z k.sid.index' ≤
    uint.Z ls'.applying) : SnpExt g ls'

  List.take (uint.Z ls.committed - uint.Z ls.applying).toNat
    (plogFrom ls.prev (ls.sents ++ ls.uents) (ls.applying + W64 1))

def logAbsorbSnap (ls : LogState) (sid : entryID) : LogState :=
  { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents, uents := ls.uents, committed := ls.committed, applied := ls.applied,
    snap := ls.snap, inprogress := ls.inprogress, applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := [], stored := ls.stored,
    apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl, sip := ls.sip,
    sapp := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps, sat := decide (ls.snap = some sid ∧ ls.sip = true), sxt := sid.index',
    stb := sid.index' }

theorem logLast_stableTo (ls : LogState) (id : entryID) : logLast (logStableTo ls id) = logLast ls

    ls.applying ∧ (logStableTo ls id).unpersisted = ls.unpersisted ∧ (logStableTo ls id).snap =
    ls.snap ∧ uint.Z ls.inprogress ≤ uint.Z (logStableTo ls id).inprogress ∧ (logStableTo ls
    id).prev = ls.prev ∧ (logStableTo ls id).stored = ls.stored

    s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, stepfn :=
    s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log, logst := logAppliedTo

    s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq } = toPState s

def StableHit.decidable (ls : LogState) (id : entryID) : Decidable (StableHit ls id) :=
  _root_.id inferInstance

theorem logHanded.proj_unpersisted (ls : LogState) : (logHanded ls).unpersisted = nextUnstable ls

def StableOk (ls : LogState) (id : entryID) : Prop :=
  StableHit ls id →
    (ls.snap = none ∨ ls.sapp = true) ∧
      ls.unpersisted = [] ∧ ls.stored = List.take (uint.Z id.index' - uint.Z ls.prev.index').toNat (ls.sents ++ ls.uents)

theorem logLast_acceptApplying (ls : LogState) (ce : List EntryM) (sz : w64) : logLast
    (logAcceptApplying ls ce sz) = logLast ls

theorem ownRaftLog_lend [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) (Hunp0 :
    ls.unpersisted = []) (Hs0 : ls.snap ≠ none) (Hlt0 : ls.lent = false) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls -∗
    ownRaftLog l (logHanded { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents, uents := ls.uents, committed :=
    ls.committed, applied := ls.applied, snap := ls.snap, inprogress := ls.inprogress, applying :=
    ls.applying, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted, stored := ls.stored, apsize := ls.apsize, apmax :=
    ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl, sip := ls.sip, lent := true, sapp
    := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps, sxt := ls.sxt, stb := ls.stb, sdt := ls.sdt }) ∗ ∃ σ, ownStorage
    ls.storage σ ∗ ⌜σ.pend = [] ∧ σ.fl = ls.fl ∧ (σ.ss.index' ≠ W64 0 → { sid := σ.ss, cl := σ.scs,
    al := σ.sal, dat := σ.sdat } ∈ ls.ksn) ∧ HdOk σ ls ∧ ∀ (sid : entryID), ls.snap = some sid →
    ls.prev = sid⌝

def logAppliedTo (ls : LogState) (index size : w64) : LogState :=
  have na := w64Max index ls.applied;
  { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents, uents := ls.uents, committed := ls.committed, applied := na, snap := ls.snap,
    inprogress := ls.inprogress, applying := w64Max ls.applying na, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted, stored := ls.stored,
    apsize := if uint.Z size < uint.Z ls.apsize then ls.apsize - size else W64 0, apmax := ls.apmax,
    storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl, sip := ls.sip, lent := ls.lent, sapp := ls.sapp,
    aps := ls.aps && decide (uint.Z na < uint.Z ls.prev.index'), sat := ls.sat, sxt := ls.sxt, stb := ls.stb,
    sdt := ls.sdt }

theorem persist_accept (prev : entryID) (σ : StorState) (sents uents : List EntryM) (ipo : Int)
    (Hidx : LogIndicesOk prev (sents ++ uents)) (Hsp : σ.prev = prev) (Hipo : 0 ≤ ipo ∧ ipo ≤
    ↑uents.length) (st : List EntryM) (H : LogPersistOk σ sents uents ipo [] st) : LogPersistOk σ
    sents uents (↑uents.length) (List.drop ipo.toNat uents) (sents ++ uents)

def StableHit (ls : LogState) (id : entryID) : Prop :=
  (logOffset ls ≤ uint.Z id.index' ∧ uint.Z id.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length) ∧
    plogTermAt ls.prev (ls.sents ++ ls.uents) id.index' = some id.term'

theorem logAbsorbSnap.proj_inprogress (ls : LogState) (sid : entryID) : (logAbsorbSnap ls
    sid).inprogress = ls.inprogress

theorem logHanded.proj_sdt (ls : LogState) : (logHanded ls).sdt = ls.sdt

    ls.storage

    ls.prev

theorem logHanded.proj_ksn (ls : LogState) : (logHanded ls).ksn = ls.ksn

theorem logAbsorbSnap_sat (ls : LogState) (sid : entryID) : (logAbsorbSnap ls sid).sat = true ↔
    ls.snap = some sid ∧ ls.sip = true

def logAcceptApplying (ls : LogState) (ce : List EntryM) (sz : w64) : LogState :=
  match ce.getLast? with
  | some e =>
    { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents, uents := ls.uents, committed := ls.committed, applied := ls.applied,
      snap := ls.snap, inprogress := ls.inprogress, applying := e.Index', unpersisted := ls.unpersisted,
      stored := ls.stored, apsize := ls.apsize + sz, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl,
      sip := ls.sip, lent := ls.lent, sapp := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps, sat := ls.sat, sxt := ls.sxt, stb := ls.stb,
      sdt := ls.sdt }
  | none => ls

    nextUnstable ls

theorem logAbsorbSnap.proj_apsize (ls : LogState) (sid : entryID) : (logAbsorbSnap ls sid).apsize =
    ls.apsize

theorem logAbsorbSnap.proj_sip (ls : LogState) (sid : entryID) : (logAbsorbSnap ls sid).sip = ls.sip

theorem logAppliedTo.proj_stored (ls : LogState) (index size : w64) : (logAppliedTo ls index
    size).stored = ls.stored

theorem logAcceptApplying_storage (ls : LogState) (ce : List EntryM) (sz : w64) : (logAcceptApplying
    ls ce sz).storage = ls.storage

theorem ownRaftLog_handout [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) (Hunp0 :
    ls.unpersisted = []) (Hs0 : ls.snap = none) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls ==∗ ownRaftLog l (logHanded ls)
    ∗ appendRight ls.storage (nextUnstable ls)

theorem logAbsorbSnap.proj_applied (ls : LogState) (sid : entryID) : (logAbsorbSnap ls sid).applied
    = ls.applied

theorem persist_handed (prev : entryID) (σ : StorState) (sents uents : List EntryM) (ipo : Int)
    (Hidx : LogIndicesOk prev (sents ++ uents)) (Hsp : σ.prev = prev) (Hipo : 0 ≤ ipo ∧ ipo ≤
    ↑uents.length) (st : List EntryM) (H : LogPersistOk σ sents uents ipo [] st) : LogPersistOk σ
    sents uents ipo (List.drop ipo.toNat uents) (sents ++ uents)

theorem logHanded.proj_apmax (ls : LogState) : (logHanded ls).apmax = ls.apmax

theorem logAbsorbSnap.proj_sapp (ls : LogState) (sid : entryID) : (logAbsorbSnap ls sid).sapp =
    ls.sapp

theorem logAppliedTo.proj_snap (ls : LogState) (index size : w64) : (logAppliedTo ls index
    size).snap = ls.snap

theorem logAppliedTo.proj_sat (ls : LogState) (index size : w64) : (logAppliedTo ls index size).sat
    = ls.sat

theorem logHanded.proj_sapp (ls : LogState) : (logHanded ls).sapp = ls.sapp

theorem logHanded.proj_sxt (ls : LogState) : (logHanded ls).sxt = ls.sxt
